title: salix aurita var. microphylla
intro: Salix aurita var. microphylla, commonly known as the dwarf willow, is a small shrub or tree species belonging to the willow family (Salicaceae). The dwarf willow has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Salix aurita var. microphylla include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which make it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
